name: resizable
title: Resizable
description: Panels separated by handles that resize them by dragging or with the keyboard. Groups can be nested.

classes.name: resizable
classes.description: A row of panels. Give it a size; the panels fill it.

classes.name: resizable__panel
classes.description: A panel. Scrolls when its content does not fit.

attributes.name: data-resizable-target="handle"
attributes.description: A handle. It resizes the panels directly before and after it.

attributes.name: data-resizable-size
attributes.description: Initial size in percent of the group. Panels without it share the remaining space equally.

attributes.name: data-resizable-min
attributes.description: Minimum size in percent. Defaults to 0.

attributes.name: data-resizable-max
attributes.description: Maximum size in percent. Defaults to 100.

events.name: velle:resizable:resize
events.description: Dispatched after the panels change size. event.detail.sizes lists every panel's size in percent.

notes: Handles are focusable separators (role="separator" with aria-valuenow). Arrow keys move them by 1%, Shift + arrow keys by 10%, and Home/End move them all the way.
To nest groups, put another .resizable inside a panel and give it the full panel size, e.g. with the b-full utility.
This replaces css-zero's wrapper around the resizable-panels-zero web component; no library is needed.
